tools.name: data_create-object
tools.description: Create object. Required: api_name, description, display_name, provider. Returns the new DataCreateObjectResponse.

params.name: api_name
params.description: This is the unique identifier for the object at the API level. It is unique within Unify and cannot be changed.

params.name: description
params.description: This is a description of the object. It is not required but will be shown in the UI to help understand the purpose of the object. Typically, this should be a short sentence or two explaining the object.

params.name: display_name
params.description: This is the user-facing object name shown within Unify. It is not required to be unique within Unify and can be changed at any time.

params.name: provider
params.description: The provider of an object represents who created and manages the object in Unify. This is used to differentiate between standard objects provided by Unify and custom objects created by a plugin or user.

tools.name: data_create-object-attribute
tools.description: Create object attribute. Required: object_name. Returns the new DataCreateObjectAttributeResponse.

tools.name: data_create-object-attribute-option
tools.description: Create object attribute option. Required: object_name, attribute_name, api_name, display_name. Returns the new DataCreateObjectAttributeOptionResponse.

params.name: api_name
params.description: This is the unique identifier for the attribute option at the API level. It is unique within the attribute and cannot be changed.

params.name: display_name
params.description: This is the user-facing attribute option name that will be shown within Unify. It is unique within the object and can be changed at any time.

tools.name: data_create-object-record
tools.description: Create object record. Required: object_name, data. Optional: validation_mode. Returns the new DataCreateObjectRecordResponse.

params.name: data
params.description: The attribute values for the new record. All required attributes on the object must be included.

tools.name: data_delete-object
tools.description: Delete object. Required: object_name. Returns the DataDeleteObjectResponse. Destructive.

tools.name: data_delete-object-attribute
tools.description: Delete object attribute. Required: object_name, attribute_name. Returns the DataDeleteObjectAttributeResponse. Destructive.

tools.name: data_delete-object-attribute-option
tools.description: Delete object attribute option. Required: object_name, attribute_name, option_name. Returns the DataDeleteObjectAttributeOptionResponse. Destructive.

tools.name: data_delete-object-record
tools.description: Delete object record. Required: object_name, record_id. Returns the DataDeleteObjectRecordResponse. Destructive.

tools.name: data_find-unique-object-record
tools.description: Find unique object record. Required: object_name, match. Returns the new DataFindUniqueObjectRecordResponse.

params.name: match
params.description: The attribute values to match against to find an existing record. At least one unique attribute must be included to ensure that at most one record is matched. Additional unique or non-unique attributes may also be included to refine the matching criteria.

tools.name: data_get-object
tools.description: Get object. Required: object_name. Returns the DataGetObjectResponse.

tools.name: data_get-object-attribute
tools.description: Get object attribute. Required: object_name, attribute_name. Returns the DataGetObjectAttributeResponse.

tools.name: data_get-object-attribute-option
tools.description: Get object attribute option. Required: object_name, attribute_name, option_name. Returns the DataGetObjectAttributeOptionResponse.

tools.name: data_get-object-record
tools.description: Get object record. Required: object_name, record_id. Returns the DataGetObjectRecordResponse.

tools.name: data_list-object-attribute-options
tools.description: List object attribute options. Required: object_name, attribute_name. Returns array of UobjectsUattributeOption.

tools.name: data_list-object-attributes
tools.description: List object attributes. Required: object_name. Returns array of UobjectsUattribute.

tools.name: data_list-objects
tools.description: List objects. Returns array of UobjectsUobject.

tools.name: data_update-object
tools.description: Update object. Required: object_name, description, display_name. Returns the updated DataUpdateObjectResponse.

params.name: description
params.description: This is a description of the object. It is not required but will be shown in the UI to help understand the purpose of the object. Typically, this should be a short sentence or two explaining the object.

params.name: display_name
params.description: This is the user-facing object name shown within Unify. It is not required to be unique within Unify and can be changed at any time.

tools.name: data_update-object-attribute
tools.description: Update object attribute. Required: object_name, attribute_name. Returns the updated DataUpdateObjectAttributeResponse.

tools.name: data_update-object-attribute-option
tools.description: Update object attribute option. Required: object_name, attribute_name, option_name, display_name. Returns the updated DataUpdateObjectAttributeOptionResponse.

params.name: display_name
params.description: This is the user-facing attribute option name that will be shown within Unify. It is unique within the object and can be changed at any time.

tools.name: data_update-object-record
tools.description: Update object record. Required: object_name, record_id, data. Optional: validation_mode. Returns the updated DataUpdateObjectRecordResponse.

params.name: data
params.description: The attribute values to update in the record.

tools.name: data_upsert-object-record
tools.description: Upsert object record. Required: object_name, match. Optional: validation_mode, create, create_or_update (plus 3 more). Returns the new DataUpsertObjectRecordResponse.

params.name: create
params.description: The attribute values to use when creating a new record if no match is found.

params.name: create_or_update
params.description: The attribute values to apply during both creation and update operations.

params.name: create_or_update_if_empty
params.description: The attribute values to apply during both creation and update-if-empty operations.

params.name: match
params.description: The attribute values to match against to find an existing record. At least one unique attribute must be included to ensure that at most one record is matched. Additional unique or non-unique attributes may also be included to refine the matching criteria.

params.name: update
params.description: The attribute values to use when updating an existing record if a match is found.

params.name: update_if_empty
params.description: The attribute values to update when a matching record is found and the existing attribute value on the record is `null`.
